question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"holding."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Holding"** is the correct verb form to use in the sentence as we can see the use of the verb **"waiting"** in the same sentence is the present participle form.
 
• So, to maintain the uniformity of the sentence, both verbs must be in the present participle form.
 
• "Holding" is in the present participle form, which is used to show an action that is ongoing or continuous.
 
• **"Holding"** means to take somebody/something and keep him/her/it in your hand, etc. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को थामे रहना)
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
